nav.goHome: Marginalia, go to the home page

home.subtitle: Write a text in English and get explained corrections, like the notes a teacher writes in the margin.
home.privacy: The text you write is sent to an AI provider to be analysed. You can delete your account and all your data at any time.

corrections.title: Corrections that teach
corrections.text: Every mistake comes with a short explanation in your language, not just the answer.

level.title: Your level at a glance
level.text: We estimate your level (A1 to C2) with every text and track your progress.

practice.title: Practice made for you
practice.text: Exercises built from the mistakes you make most often.
